scripts.backend:lint: sh -lc 'cd backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m ruff check backend tests; else python3 -m ruff check backend tests; fi'
scripts.backend:test: sh -lc 'cd backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest; else python3 -m pytest; fi'
scripts.backend:reconcile: sh -lc 'cd backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m backend.workers.reconcile; else python3 -m backend.workers.reconcile; fi'
scripts.qa:frontend: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn build
scripts.qa: yarn qa:frontend && yarn qa:backend && yarn test:e2e
